latestProposalIntake.priorityPolicy: Prefer strong, supportable concepts that fit the currently playable clinic before later-level or future-hospital concepts. Re-rank the whole unreviewed pool whenever a newer workbook is ingested.

records.scopeNote: Begin enteral nutrition as soon as feasible within 24 hours after extensive burn once adequately resuscitated and without an enteral contraindication; the retained eight-hour presentation is context rather than a universal cutoff.

Permanent macroporous monofilament synthetic mesh is selected only after a recognized enterotomy is securely repaired, source control is adequate, contamination is minimal and controlled, gross spillage is absent, and the team has already chosen a single-stage ventral or incisional hernia repair.

Right thoracotomy is the canonical exposure for selected localized proximal or middle thoracic esophageal, intrathoracic tracheal, and azygos injuries; right posterolateral thoracotomy is context-specific to planned repair in a stable or stabilized patient and is not the default resuscitative trauma incision.

Resection extent is selected from disease location and integrity of the base and adjacent ileum: long narrow tip-only inflammation permits simple diverticulectomy, while the approved segmental variants specify base and adjacent-ileal involvement. A base width of 2 cm or greater is retained only as a source-specific small-series definition, not a universal cutoff.

The concept teaches higher observed perioperative mortality among women after elective intact AAA repair at the group level, including both EVAR and open repair, without making the association deterministic for an individual patient or using it to choose a repair approach.

Initial specialist surveillance is separated from the location-specific option of function-preserving surgery for persistently progressing symptomatic abdominal-wall disease after multidisciplinary review; the later surveillance visit is authored rather than simulated with facility time.

Stable nonbleeding-visible-vessel decisions are staged for Level 2 Endoscopy; active-bleeding decisions are reserved for Future Hospital Floor. Epinephrine alone is inadequate, while accepted thermal or mechanical therapy may be definitive without epinephrine in the approved contexts.

After Study, use the observed result to adopt, adapt, or abandon the tested change and prepare the next linked PDSA cycle. The approved humor is confined to plausible ASC project framing and does not alter the measured result or answer key.

A fit patient with biopsy-confirmed, multidisciplinary-defined resectable pancreatic-tail adenocarcinoma and no distant metastases is counseled or referred for distal pancreatectomy with splenectomy if proceeding to surgery. Four clinic variants are active at L0; one operative-planning variant is deferred to Future Hospital OR while retaining the same FSRS identity. Absence of metastases alone is not treated as proof of resectability, and treatment sequencing is outside scope.

Recognize persistent neutropenia in established rheumatoid arthritis after important mimics are excluded; splenomegaly is common but not mandatory. Methotrexate is usual first-line disease-modifying treatment, bridge/supportive therapy remains distinct, and splenectomy is considered only for recurrent infections despite adequate specialist-directed medical therapy.

FHH is evaluated with paired serum and 24-hour urine calcium-creatinine measurements. Relative hypocalciuria and family history raise suspicion but do not establish the diagnosis alone; approved confirmed-management variants use a pathogenic CASR result and uncomplicated disease. Reassure and observe rather than perform routine parathyroid surgery.
